motor: 4108-class gimbal, 7 pole pairs, to be measured
notes: Phase-to-phase resistance measured 0.30/0.29/0.30 ohm with a milliohm meter, so R_phase = 0.15 ohm: a low-resistance drone-class motor, not a gimbal motor. R_total adds two DRV8316 FETs (~0.2 ohm) and must be measured with the DC hold test. The bus voltage read 5% low because the library used the shortest ADC sampling time on a 4.3k source; the library now uses 247.5 cycles, so the divider ratio is the datasheet 11.0 again.

provenance.vbus_scale: datasheet (4.7k/47k); ADC sampling time fixed in the library
